If you do not meet Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) for two or three consecutive semesters, you must meet with an Academic Advisor to develop a plan for improving your academic progress and/or update an existing plan, to ensure that you are making progress toward completing your degree and to remain eligible for Chafee grant funding.

You and your Academic Advisors will work together to develop a Success Plan that addresses the circumstances that led to you not meeting SAP.
